display_name: LoRa 原生 8,192 点分频残差更新与同预算续训（Full）
description: One matched baseline continuation isolates training budget for the registered previous alignment trial. The architectural candidate learns a bounded real gain for each observed spectral innovation, retaining phase and full packet support.
authorization: Active LoRa native raw performance goal, frozen E104 training loss and high-confidence source clean U_s pseudo-label authorization.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: Native 8192-point complex recovery. Complete eight chirps through a fixed phase tracker. The candidate FFT update uses only the observation and the trainable coarse estimate. Frozen E104 preprocessing remains 8x2x432.
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Authorized L_s and U_s capturing native source IQ, original generic waveform simulation, L_s true CE, frozen E104 clean U_s pseudo-CE at confidence .95; no U_s TX, V, exact benchmark traces or target during training. Both rows fixed before official Full seven-view prediction.

checkpoint.initialization: Same immutable legal 313796-parameter native E104 18k parent in both. Restart AdamW. Candidate adds 10785 trainable parameters, with zero final gains so it starts at identical output.

sources.role: Same raw observation contract and pretarget source-qualified initialization. Recursively verify formal archival parent.
Same-contract G initialization and archived Full comparison.
Frozen source training teacher and evaluation default head.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Pretarget source-selected common parent; same-contract role binding. Prior alignment trial contributes an archived comparison, with no trained weights inherited. Its observed target ordering does not select the new arms.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 20000 continuations. Both enter Full for all seven views regardless of source accuracy. Source V is reference only. Target performance requires at least 162000/180000, 25500/30000 and 28566/30000 for practical six, low urban and clean respectively.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 [0,7,2,6,3], min 12 GiB actual free and fewer than 8 contexts, at most two workers and one per card.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on illegal input roles, failed E104 or gain gradient, candidate not identical to parent before updates, nonfinite fit, failed freeze, or incomplete matched Full predictions. Source-reference failure is diagnostic and recorded.

notes: Hypothesis: a per-frequency signed real update made only along the observed-minus-coarse innovation corrects under- or over-subtraction while preserving the per-chirp complex direction. Its DC term is exactly zero.

Same frequency gains module on all eight chirps. Six inputs are the local and across-chirp mean powers of observation, coarse estimate and their residual, all relative to observation-only outer-frequency noise proxy. No across-chirp averaging of complex samples.

Both arms use the original fixed E104 true and pseudo-label losses, raw waveform and spectral losses, and clean consistency. No prior alignment loss in either arm. The previous alignment trial is only a separately frozen archived comparison for budget attribution.

The matched baseline continuation retains the common native architecture, seed, data/perturbation draw, optimizer and budget from the alignment run. The candidate jointly trains the native base and the added module. The zero initialized gain starts at the baseline exactly.

The fixed matrix is clean plus all six Full practical views on the same 30000 physical packets and 15 unseen receivers. Both arms evaluated once after complete freeze. Source V is only a reference, no performance gate.
